title: Add variant snapshot store and changelog prioritizer
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a persisted variant snapshot store and a heuristic changelog prioritizer for automated release-note drafts; migration adds snapshots table, API and UI hooks; no customer-visible API breaking changes.
description:
Context and motivation: We frequently receive onboarding requests where model variants diverge subtly (tokenization tweaks, quantized builds, or perf-only forks). Authors currently hand-write release notes and maintain separate ad-hoc snapshot artifacts, which makes rollbacks and impact analysis error-prone. This change introduces a persisted 'variant snapshot' artifact and an automated 'changelog prioritizer' that surfaces the most likely high-impact deltas to release-note writers.

Goals: 1) Persist lightweight, canonical snapshots for each model variant so diffs are reproducible and linkable in changelogs. 2) Compute a traffic-weighted impact score (perf delta * request share + semantic-change heuristic) to rank changelog entries. 3) Emit an auto-drafted prioritized release notes bundle as a developer-editable template accessible from the registry UI and CLI. 4) Keep the runtime cost low and the snapshot storage compact (dedup and bloom-filter-assisted reference).

What this PR does (high-level): - Adds a snapshot persistence layer (snapshots table + compact blob format + index by model:variant:seed). - Implements snapshot_store service with delta computation and stable-content hash (blake2b-64) for identity and compact dedupe. - Adds changelog prioritizer module: calculates impact_score = weighted_sum([perf_delta_ms_norm, token_cost_delta, traffic_share_estimate, semantic_change_score]) and exposes a prioritization API and template generator. - Adds a UI card to registry webapp to preview prioritized autodrafts and accept/adjust weights. - Adds a CLI command 'redwood-registry snapshot:export --variant' to produce portable snapshot bundles and templated release notes. - Ships DB migration and a one-time backfill/seed script for environments with existing variant tags.

Commits summary (top-level): - 4c9e0b1: introduce snapshot table schema and migration - 7a2d3f4: implement snapshot_store read/write/dedupe - b1f8c9a: add stable hashing and compact blob serializer - 9d1a2b0: implement changelog_prioritizer with default weights and unit tests - 2ac4b55: add web UI card and wire to prioritizer API - f7e0e11: CLI snapshot export & import hooks - 1b3c9ff: observability: metrics + alert for unexpectedly large snapshot payloads - 5f8d2aa: docs and onboarding guide for snapshot workflows

Files changed (high-level): - migration adds snapshots table with reference columns and blob column for compressed manifest. - services/registry gains snapshot_store and prioritizer service modules (~500 LOC). - webapp includes a new ChangelogPrioritizerCard and small form for weight overrides. - CLI adds a new subcommand and azure-s3-compatible upload helper. - tests include unit coverage for hashing, dedupe, priority ranking, and a tiny e2e for export/import.

Design/implementation notes and trade-offs: - Snapshot blob remains intentionally compact: we store lightweight manifests (tokenizer fingerprint, config diff, perf fingerprints) rather than full model files; external storage references (artifact URLs) are supported for large binaries. - Hashing: chosen blake2b-64 for speed and stable cross-language determinism with explicit canonical serialization. - Prioritization is heuristic-driven and configurable per-org via a weights config and small ML-derived semantic-change signal (cosine between embedding centroids). We ship conservative defaults. - Backfill is idempotent and uses snapshot hash to avoid re-inserting duplicates.

Migration notes: - Includes offline migration SQL: migrations/202502_add_variant_snapshots.sql. - Seed script scripts/seed_default_priorities.py runs as a one-off to seed organization-level default weights. - Ops note: the migration can be run with the offline flag; snapshot store tolerates missing snapshots in read path.

Testing and CI: - Local unit tests added under tests/ cover dedupe, hashing, ranking heuristics. - Integration e2e in CI runs a headless export/import scenario (small sample model fixtures). - CI summary: initial run failed on linting (TSX formatting) and a flakey test test_changelog_prioritizer::test_traffic_weighted_rank which was fixed by stabilizing time mocking. Final CI status: pass.

Review conversation (abridged): - Jordan Patel (reviewer): "Nice end-to-end story. Two asks: (1) can we make the default weights configurable per-team? (2) document the privacy implications of storing tokenizer fingerprints." Author reply (Maya): "(1) Yes—weights are org-scoped and exposed in the UI; added seed script + config. (2) Tokenizer fingerprints are irreversibly hashed and do not include training data; expanded docs section to clarify." - Ravi Shah: "DB migration looks fine but please ensure index on (model_id, variant_id, hash) to avoid scans." Author: "Added composite index and updated migration SQL." - Anya Gomez: "Prefer feature flag rollout for the UI card." Author: "Wrapped UI behind feature flag 'changelog_prioritizer' and defaulted to on for internal tenants."

Operational considerations: - Observability: added snapshots.size_bytes and snapshot.dedupe_ratio metrics; alert when avg payload > 1MB. - Cost: snapshot payloads dedupe aggressively; large model binaries are stored externally. - Rollout: feature flag + canary users in registry-qa first, then org-by-org enable.

Backwards compatibility and security: - No breaking external API changes; new API endpoints are additive. - Snapshot blobs are access-controlled via existing registry ACLs; export CLI requires API token with export scope. - No plaintext customer data is introduced; tokenizer fingerprints are hashed.

Follow-ups and future work: - Add a lightweight 'auto-summary' generator that converts prioritized diffs into plain-English bullet points (ENG-3297). - Telemetry: track which autodrafts are accepted/edited by writers to tune prioritizer. - Consider compact binary diff format for perf fingerprints to further reduce size.

Merge outcome: merged into main via squash on 2025-02-02 after CI green and approvals from Jordan and Ravi.

Related work and references: - Linear: ENG-3145 (variant snapshots), ENG-3297 (autodraft summarizer) - Related tickets: SUP-42 (customer request for more consistent release notes)

If you want to run locally: 1) apply migration: ./scripts/db-migrate up 202502_add_variant_snapshots.sql 2) seed defaults: python3 scripts/seed_default_priorities.py --env=dev 3) start registry and webapp, enable feature flag 'changelog_prioritizer'

Notes for reviewers picking up follow-ups: the prioritizer core is intentionally deterministic and small; adding ML-derived knobs should be a separate follow-up with opt-in telemetry.
